reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (tokenless per-employer careers-site jobs API; apply only through the employer's private

endpoints.notes: query `page` (default 1), `perPage` (default 20), `details` (bool, "Form" — include the application form), `departments[]` (ids), `locations[]`, `languageCode`; response is a generic `PagingResult` (job fields not enumerated in the spec)
see Customer swagger; also `GET /v2/candidates/{id}/applications/{applicationId}`, `move_to_stage`, `disqualify`, education / experience sub-resources

endpoints.purpose: webhooks ("register a URL which will have notifications posted to it")

reference.limits: - Authenticated API: "All API calls are limited to 600 requests every 10 minutes" (Requests page). - Public API: not published. - Terms and Conditions (help.talentlyft.com article 21993), s.7.5 "Restricted actions": no modifying / translating / derivative copies, no reverse engineering, no redistributing access. No clause about bots, scraping or automated applications was found; the Public API is expressly offered for rendering jobs without a token. - Governing law Croatia (s.8.1).

config_fields.name: subdomain
config_fields.help: The company's TalentLyft careers-site subdomain, e.g. 'demo' in https://demo.talentlyft.com.

search.note: Public Customer API ('rendering jobs without API token') for ONE company (config subdomain): GET https://api.talentlyft.com/v2/public/{subdomain}/jobs with page ('default 1'), perPage ('default 20') and details=true, returning a paging result {Results, Count, Page, PerPage, Pages}. The spec (https://api.talentlyft.com/swagger/public/swagger.json) has no keyword filter (departments and locations take ids), so query/location are not sent — filter client-side. The job objects are untyped in the spec; the mapped names (Id, Title, City, ShortlinkUrl, Description) are from a live response read 2026-09-25, with Country, Department, Requirements and JobTags in raw.

not_offered.me: The Public Customer API needs no token and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The public API reference documents only the jobs, departments and locations lists; there is no public single-job endpoint. Re-read the record from the search hit.
not_offered.apply: Creating candidates/applications is in the Private Customer API with the company's API token ('manipulation of candidates … candidate applications'), not a candidate credential; candidates apply through the job's ShortlinkUrl.
not_offered.list_messages: No candidate messaging in the public API.

live_check.notes: verified against the public subdomain span; all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
